desc:
This is a brief first look at what impact the changes to SpaceX's proposed starlink network from the new November 2018 filing might have on how the network functions.

My original video, based on their original plans, that also shows phase 2 is here:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=AdKNCBrkZQ4

The research paper discussing this in more details is here:
http://nrg.cs.ucl.ac.uk/mjh/starlink-draft.p
